Nebula ML Company Portal

Primary application method for this role:
- Submit by email to careers@nebula-ml.ai
- Attach a tailored resume and a role-specific cover letter
- Record the application in workspace/submission_record.json after submission

Portal policy notes:
- Treat the address listed in workspace/submission_policy.json as the canonical submission target unless a later approved override exists in MEMORY.md.
- If the application package is sent by email, set channel to "email".
- If a compliance block appears below, complete the required step before final submission.
